fields.acceptance: A testscript with fake systemctl and loginctl on PATH: install writes $HOME/.config/systemd/user/rhiza-<repo>.service with ExecStart running rhiza daemon, the main checkout as WorkingDirectory, Restart=always and After=rex.service, then calls systemctl --user daemon-reload, systemctl --user enable --now and loginctl enable-linger; a second install changes nothing; uninstall calls systemctl --user disable --now and removes the file; with no systemctl on PATH both exit 2 naming systemd
fields.statement: rhiza daemon install writes and enables a systemd user unit that runs this repo's daemon (in the main checkout, Restart=always, after rex.service) and turns on lingering, and rhiza daemon uninstall stops, disables and removes it; where systemd is missing both say so and change nothing

fields.acceptance: A testscript runs rhiza daemon --once against a fake Rex with REX_SESSION unset: when rex session ls lacks rhiza-<repo> the daemon creates it once and opens the run's tab with -s rhiza-<repo>; with the session present it creates none; with REX_SESSION set to another session the tab still opens in rhiza-<repo>
fields.statement: The daemon opens every tab it starts (run, resume and plan-request tabs) in the Rex session rhiza-<repo>, named after the main checkout's folder, creating that session on its Rex server when missing, so it needs no Rex tab or REX_SESSION of its own

fields.acceptance: Testscripts with a fake systemctl and a fake Rex: with the unit installed, start calls systemctl --user start and stop calls systemctl --user stop, and daemon status --json reports mode service; with none, start opens a rex window named 'rhiza daemon' running rhiza daemon, stop ends that daemon, and status reports mode tab; a unit test on the autonomy app's fake runner shows d calling daemon start when stopped and daemon stop when running
fields.statement: rhiza daemon start and rhiza daemon stop start or stop this repo's daemon the way its installation runs it: through the systemd unit when rhiza daemon install wrote one, else in the Rex tab 'rhiza daemon' in the repo's session; the autonomy app's d key calls them, and daemon status says which mode runs
